about_the_game:
Carve a path through this planet:

Battle your way through a variety of environments, and fix broken down portals using power cores you find in the environment. With your grit, wits, and some elbow grease you’ll overcome and overpower any obstacle in your way.

String together your on unique attacks:

In Blights Grasp you can mix and match your different fighting styles with the alien elements you can harness, creating a variety of effects and combinations. The act of mixing these elements and styles is quick, allowing for on the fly moves and strategies. 

Features:

  • A 3rd Person Action Game centering on melee combat.

  • Use your ranged attack to extend combos and hit far away enemies.

  • Collect power cores to buy power ups and fix portals.

  • Navigate environments using your jumps and dashes.

  • Switch between different fighting styles and elements using the radial menu.

content_descriptors.notes: Blights Grasp contains cartoon and fantasy violence within it's combat encounters. Contains a gamey and cartoonish depiction of violent acts such as punching with vibrant colorful effects and the use of spells and magic to make attacks stronger.

short_description: Explore a foreign planet on a journey to find your lost sister and a cure for this corrupted world. Fight through waves of enemies using a combination of this world's elements. Will you be able to piece together a solution or will it already be too late.
